# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old (in Volume 1)  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight, slender-less lad with a wide, freckle-covered face, a round, expressionless visage, and a joy-filled smile.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

He is emotionless, exceptionally bashful, and suffers from an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. He is known to be hard-working, sensible, dependable, and free of negative vices.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_

## Traits

- Bashful  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
- Hard-working  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## History

Barney drives a double-seated buggy to Pale Sands along with his sister Odette to carry Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke to a concert. He harbors immense, silent admiration for Nell and takes great pride in driving her, though he sits quietly in a corner during events and speaks very little. He eventually asks his sister Odette to propose marriage to Nell on his behalf after his father bestows the upper farm upon him, offering to wait until she finishes college. Following Nell's firm refusal, Barney marries Nettie Scobie, a union favored by his mother, and their 'appearing out' takes place on a Sunday at church.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
